scope: Offline cavity triangulation of app-collected endpoints reordered by native-observed facet order for the concave control.
method: Map app-collected points to corresponding captured native projected coordinates, retain app endpoint-order variants and native source corners, run the earlier exact-incircle sequential cavity prototype, and compare unordered triangles with captured native initial triangulations.
limitations: Uses captured native projection and facet order, not an application tree or projection implementation.
Compares initial triangulation only; constraints, seams, production behavior and full output parity are not established.
Only one concave control; endpoint rules remain unknown.
interpretation: Although point vectors differ, the three tested endpoint orderings all yield the captured initial facets on both concave faces in this prototype. Endpoint ordering is not established as a cause of this control’s facet mismatch.
